discoveries.discovery: the dependency graph is not guaranteed to be a tree, so the closure walk must terminate on a cycle; and the closure must be followed to its end, however far from the changed node it reaches; and the affected set is a CLOSURE: an entry computed from a stale node is itself stale, transitively; and the whole input must be validated before the first deletion, so a refused call leaves the caller's cache exactly as it was; and an entry naming a dependency the cache does not hold cannot be shown to be unaffected, so it must not survive
